Bibi Blocksberg - Der Magische Hexenkrei.name: Bibi Blocksberg: Der Magische Hexenkreis
Bibi Blocksberg - Der Magische Hexenkrei.summary: In this game teenage witch Bibi navigates isometric levels to help out friends and family and flies her broom in 2D side-scrolling levels to fix the mess evil witch Malicia has caused in the city of Neustadt.

Earthworm Jim.name: Earthworm Jim
Earthworm Jim.summary: The Super NES version has altered graphics, with different backgrounds and special effects, but lacked some sound effects and one of the levels from the Genesis version (titled "Intestinal Distress").

Ghost Rider.name: Ghost Rider
Ghost Rider.summary: The Ghost Rider feature film follows superstar motorcycle stunt rider Johnny Blaze as he strikes a deal with the vile Mephistopheles for the most precious of commodities - his immortal soul. Now Johnny Blaze is forever destined to ride night after night as the host to the powerful supernatural entity known as the Ghost Rider. The video game continues the storyline, dropping players into the role of Blaze as he is transformed into a super hero with powers to avenge any evil he encounters. Featuring many of the characters and motorcycles from the comic book and movie, Ghost Rider engages gamers in an immersive, supernatural third person world with a seamless blend of hand-to-hand combat and high-speed motorcycle action.

Jikkyou World Soccer Pocket 2.name: International Superstar Soccer Advance
Jikkyou World Soccer Pocket 2.summary: International Superstar Soccer Advance is a Sports game, developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Osaka and published by Konami, which was released in Europe in 2003.

Shining Soul II.name: Shining Soul II
Shining Soul II.summary: As monsters begin to appear in the kingdom Klantol, King Marcel announces a grand tournament at the coliseum to find a hero that can protect the country. Now, as a mighty Brawler, Priestess, Dark Wizard, or Ninja, you must accept the king's challenge. Each character has certain strengths and weaknesses that can mean the difference between victory and defeat in single-player, multiplayer, or cooperative multiplayer modes. In addition to valuable weapons and armor, you can equip your party with Force Links, which, when combined, create a Shining Force--a powerful weapon capable of decimating the enemy forces.

WTA Tour Tennis.name: WTA Tour Tennis
WTA Tour Tennis.summary: This is a Konami game with the license of the official WTA Tour. Featuring many of the world's most famous female tennis players, it is one of the underdogs of the Game Boy Advance handheld console.
